metrics.graph_accuracy: Entrywise accuracy over all slope support matrices after bottom-up Hungarian alignment.
metrics.parameter_mse: Per-replicate mean squared error over prop and all coefficient matrices, including intercepts.
metrics.parameter_rmse_paper: sqrt(mean(parameter_mse after median +/- 3 scaled-MAD outlier removal)).
metrics.alignment: Squared-L2 column assignment from the observed layer upward; corresponding rows of the next coefficient matrix are permuted.

paper_reference.parameters: Equation (S.36), sparse identifiable B_s; positive 4/3 paired loading.
paper_reference.D3_note: No D=3 Bernoulli result is reported; this scenario recursively extends equation (S.36) to (54,18,6,2).
paper_reference.N16000_note: The paper tables end at N=8000; N=16000 is an added extrapolation.
